title: Well-Only Rainbows
html:
These rainbows are not on the shared pile every boss corpse rolls, and they are not a named lair-chest list. You get them from the Wishing Well. The Well does not use dungeon loot percent.

Hitting the Well-specific pile is 1 in 20 per item. A paid toss drops two items, so about 1 in 10 to see that pile at least once. That 1 in 20 is the whole pile — pirate, ears, Charge!, NC Hammer, named lair pieces, books, gold brick — not one name. Armor is the common branch. A given name is a lot rarer than 1 in 20. The full table is on Wishing Well.

Named lair pieces and Nacho Supreme can also come from the Well once you are high enough for that dungeon. Those lists are on Boss Lair Rainbows. They are not only-Well.

Drop odds for boss corpses and chests are on Rainbow Drops. Names that no longer drop anywhere are on Discontinued Rainbows.

Contents

  • 1 Pirate set
  • 2 Helms
  • 3 Weapon
  • 4 Not rainbows
  • 5 Seasonal Well
  • 6 Rough odds

Pirate set

The pirate look is Well-only. You will not see these names on a boss corpse or a lair chest.

  • Puffy Shirt of the High Seas
  • Sea Bird Projectile Protector of the Scallywag
  • 5 Fleshy and 1 Metal Hook Holders
  • Salty Toes of the Low Tide
  • Portable Poop Decks

Helms

  • Squeaks
  • Doesn't Squeak
  • Feathered Cap
  • Charge!

Squeaks and Doesn't Squeak are the mouse-ear pair. They still drop. From 15.

Weapon

  • NC Hammer

Not rainbows

The ninja look from the Well is unique (purple), not rainbow. Same Well, different color.

Seasonal Well

When the holiday pack is on, the Well can also spit seasonal names. Those are not the everyday Well-only list. Known seasonal rainbows include:

  • Love/Hate (mostly Hate)
  • Flower Power
  • Sunny Side Up Yours

Holiday hats such as Shivery's Scrapper Hat can also come out of the Well when that look is in the mix.

Rough odds

This is a guess. The 1 in 20 is solid. The split after that is not. If the Well picks one name from each pile the same way the rest of loot works — common rows win more often, then it splits again — a paid toss (two items) is in this ballpark:

  • Pirate armor or Charge!: about 1 in 1,500 to 3,500 for that name.
  • Squeaks / Doesn't Squeak: worse. Extra helm split, and the purple ninja / pimp hats sit on that same list. About 1 in 3,000 to 8,000.
  • NC Hammer: behind the weapon branch. About 1 in 2,000 to 6,000. A bit hotter before 80, when the chair is not in that mace list yet.

Do not treat 1 in 20 as the odds for one name. The pile hits that often. The name does not.
